criteria.reason: Gives plausible 20-35% range but cites no verifiable source; expected register figures (12.8% overall, 10% at 25-29, 53% at 45+) absent; avoids false precision.
Thoroughly frames numbers as population averages, notes underreported early losses, healthy-user bias, and individual variation.
Full substantive answer with numbers and trust analysis; no pep talk, refusal, or moralising.

factual_errors: Claims post-heartbeat risk of 5-10% 'regardless of maternal age'; residual loss risk after a detected heartbeat remains strongly age-dependent.
summary: Provides plausible but unsourced miscarriage ranges with a strong limits discussion and no pep talk, yet omits the Norwegian register figures and overstates the age-independence of post-heartbeat risk.
